channel.title: The Greek Herald - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Greek Herald (greekherald.com.au)

item.title: Kalamata Society of Melbourne celebrates liberation anniversary with dinner dance
item.description: More than 350 guests came together in Melbourne to celebrate Kalamata’s liberation anniversary with a vibrant night of music and dance.

item.title: Pan-Thessalian Federation of NSW holds Annual General Meeting
item.description: The Pan-Thessalian Federation of NSW “Karaiskakis” successfully held its Annual General Meeting (AGM) on Sunday, March 22.

item.title: AHEPA Unit 2 Athena luncheon raises vital funds for head and neck cancer support
item.description: AHEPA Unit 2 Athena, Daughters of Penelope, held its annual luncheon and raised $26,000 for Head and Neck Cancer Australia - HANCA.

item.title: Greek Australian educator speaks out at first Victorian teachers strike in 13 years
item.description: For the first time in 13 years, Victorian public school teachers, principals and education support staff marched for their rights.

item.title: Dionysios Solomos Awards 2026 celebrate excellence in Greek language education
item.description: The Greek Orthodox Community of NSW (GOCNSW) proudly hosted the Dionysios Solomos Awards 2026, as part of the 44th Greek Festival of Sydney.

item.title: Athens student parade honours national anniversary
item.description: Students filled the streets of central Athens on Tuesday in a major parade which marked the anniversary of Greek Independence Day.

item.title: Accused Easey St killer Perry Kouroumblis charged with rape
item.description: A rape charge that was thrown out by a magistrate last year has been reinstated against alleged Easey St killer Perry Kouroumblis.

item.title: Nick Koutivas among Melbourne's most wanted accused criminals
item.description: 53-year-old Nick Koutivas is known to frequent the St Kilda area and is wanted for alleged burglary, theft, and handling stolen goods.

item.title: Simela Petridis secures spot in Australian Idol Top 8
item.description: Australian Idol contestant Simela Petridis has advanced to the Top 8 after Tuesday night's episode of the country’s singing competition.

item.title: Spiri Tsintziras highlights value of Writers Victoria as funding future questioned
item.description: Greek Australian author Spiri Tsintziras has spoken out as Writers Victoria faces closure, warning of the impact on emerging writers.

item.title: 1821: Cyprus’ sacrifice and the enduring spirit of March 25
item.description: For the Cyprus Community of NSW, March 25 is both a celebration of Greece’s liberation and a remembrance of Cyprus’ own sacrifice.

item.title: 25 March 1821: The making of Modern Greece
item.description: Names such as Kolokotronis, Karaiskakis, Diakos, and Bouboulina were learned from an early age and commemorated in parades each March.

item.title: Melbourne fertility pioneer Nick Lolatgis set to retire early
item.description: Dr Lolatgis has abruptly announced his retirement, leaving behind a months-long wait list for his breakthrough pregnancy treatment.

item.title: Mitsotakis addresses Greek Australians in March 25 message amid postponed visit
item.description: Greek PM Kyriakos Mitsotakis has delivered a video message to the Greek Australian community marking the Greek War of Independence.

item.title: Apostolakis and Trimis named on Young Matildas AFC U-20 Women's Asian Cup squad
item.description: Greek Australian players Alexia Apostolakis and Peta Trimis join CommBank Young Matildas new squad for AFC U-20 Women's Asian Cup.
